feeds.title: Women'n Art
feeds.description: Women'n Art is a website committed to the role of women in the arts and culture. Natasha Moura's main objective is to promote women in visual arts, however, from time to time we will highlight the work of other talented women who have developed their work in other artistic fields such as music or literature.

feeds.title: Raw Femme
feeds.description: Latina-owned, Raw Femme began as an online publication in 2013 that put a spotlight on the talent of emerging women-identifying artists. We are a multi-faceted, artistically inclined platform fueled by creative and artistic women that host local women-centric events, produce online editorial content, and collaborate with other like-minded organizations.

feeds.title: NMWA Blog
feeds.description: The National Museum of Women in the Arts (NMWA) brings recognition to the achievements of women artists of all periods and nationalities by exhibiting, preserving, and teaching the public about their accomplishments. Read the latest from the Broad Strokes Blog. Learn about the women artists in NMWA's collections, explore the museum's exhibitions in greater detail, & more.

feeds.title: Women's Caucus for Art
feeds.description: The mission of the Women's Caucus for Art is to create community through art, education, and social activism. WCA is committed to recognizing the contribution of women in the arts; providing women with leadership opportunities and professional development.

feeds.title: Women In Art Blog
feeds.description: In our Blog, Art Sense - The Collective Female Mind, we share on the work WIAOTT is doing in our communities. You'll hear from our member artists about their artistic journies and learn how they uncovered and developed their talent. We'll also share tips on using and mastering various media and materials.

feeds.title: #Womensart Blog
feeds.description: #WOMENSART also creates an integral opportunity to promote women's self-representation and to explore the female rather than the much more scrutinized 'male gaze'. Celebrating women's art and creativity by not forgetting them, is what her aim is. The blog is filled with women in the past along with their artwork.

feeds.title: Women Arts Blog
feeds.description: WomenArts is dedicated to increasing the visibility of women artists in all art forms. We share news about trailblazing women artists and gender parity activists all year long. Find the latest articles on women and arts.

feeds.title: Woman Seeking Art
feeds.description: Woman Seeking Art is who and what I am. I am a ceramic artist, art lover, mother of three, and now blogger. The blogs I regularly follow entertain and inspire me, but also make me feel part of a community with common tastes, and help me stay connected to things I love.

feeds.title: Lisa Matrundola Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Matrundola is a contemporary, figurative oil painter and mixed media sculptor. Figurative paintings and sculptures by Atlanta artists Lisa Matrundola.Juried exhibitions, artist residencies, awards and recognition are posted here. I also enjoy posting process videos.

feeds.title: ArtistAnd Blog
feeds.description: Learn about different techniques and how to draw like an ArtistAnd. Their blog gives insightful details on how to improve your skills and learn about the ways of the old masters. ArtistAnd is a Art collective that focuses on exploring creative potential in every business as well as paintings for film and TV using traditional oil painting techniques to create masterpieces

feeds.title: Cathy Hayes Blog
feeds.description: Cathy Hayes' lavishly expressive paint and mixed media work is the culmination of a multifarious assemblage of tropical, metropolitan, vernacular and cultivated influences. Visit Artist Blog by Cathy Hayes which features all her artwork, inspirations and more.

feeds.title: Petra Meikle de Vlas Blog
feeds.description: Petra Meikle de Vlas is an exciting, mixed media, 3 dimensional, realism to abstract artist. Drawing on her unique life experiences and her passion for the diversity of nature, she is inspired by the natural world around her. Here you can find all her blog posts talking about her life as an artist, methods, and vivid experiences.

feeds.title: That Artist Woman
feeds.description: Gail Barte is a self-employed art consultant/educator in the Calgary area, who has provided 'artist in Residence' programs for the last 13 years. Discovering life one art adventure at a time. Her blog is a complete guide to keeping kids entertained and engaged through activities.
